name: Rework tabs within settings page.
description:
Right now we have a concept of "global" and "own list" for many settings inside of preferences.

It's hard for the user to navigate this.

- Remove tabs from the UI

- Instead of tabs, duplicate the sidebar item, once for global and once for the board sections. Ie. stages should have an item under the "Global" section AND under "Board: <board name>". Under global it shows items that are global, under board it shows the board level items. Make sure to include verbiage about inhertance.

comments.author: sunny

comments.body: Complexity 3/10. Branch codex/row-45-settings-scopes, based on current origin/main (1435f6f). Plan: keep Global and Board settings entries fixed to their scope, remove Stages/Fields level tabs and shortcut, explain inheritance and first-edit overrides, update docs, run all four checks, and capture screenshots. ROW-42 coordination: preserve Preferences and its search-scope setting; expected shared interface is the existing settings route table.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Factory answer from the Story’s stated scope: include Stage Prompts. The description says to remove settings scope tabs and duplicate sidebar items under Global and Board sections; it does not exempt Plugin settings. Preserve Plugin ownership while making separate Global/Board entries and explaining inheritance.
